claims.text: Mild arthralgias: often no tx, or NSAIDs;
claims.quote: Musculoskeletal involvement: Mild arthralgias in most patients often do not require treatment or respond well to nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).

claims.text: inflammatory arthritis: DMARDs, HCQ (200-400 mg daily) and MTX;
claims.quote: Inflammatory arthritis can be managed with disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs such as HCQ (200-400 mg daily) and MTX.

claims.text: add MTX if no response to HCQ;
claims.quote: MTX is added if patients do not respond to HCQ.

claims.text: refractory severe inflammatory arthritis: anti-TNF agents.
claims.quote: Antitumor necrosis factor agents can be used in refractory severe inflammatory arthritis.
